items.name: WriteContext
items.summary: A write context for a specific partition or an unpartitioned table. Created by [`Transaction::partitioned_write_context`] or [`Transaction::unpartitioned_write_context`].

methods.name: logical_schema
methods.summary: Returns the schema which connectors' logical data should conform to.

methods.name: logical_to_physical
methods.summary: Returns the expression that transforms logical data to physical data for writing.

methods.name: new_deletion_vector_path
methods.summary: Generate a new unique absolute URL for a deletion vector file.

methods.name: physical_partition_values
methods.summary: Returns the serialized partition values for this write context. Keys are physical column names; values are protocol-serialized strings (`None` = null).

methods.name: physical_schema
methods.summary: Returns the physical schema (partition columns removed if applicable, column mapping applied). Partition columns are kept when `materializePartitionColumns` is enabled.

methods.name: resolve_file_path
methods.summary: Computes the relative `add.path` value for the Delta log from a file's absolute URL.

methods.name: stats_columns
methods.summary: Returns the column names that should have statistics collected during writes.

methods.name: write_dir
